summary_1line: Krishna gifts lavish wealth to the Pandavas; news of Draupadi’s marriage spreads, alarming Kauravas while Vidura informs Dhritarashtra and Duryodhana begins plotting.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna’s envoys present heaps of gold coins, jeweled vessels, elephants, and richly dressed maidservants before Yudhishthira.
Bhima stands gripping an uprooted tree as frightened kings recoil in memory of his fury at Draupadi’s self-choice.
In a dim chamber, Duryodhana and Karna lean toward the blind king Dhritarashtra, whispering of plans to weaken the Pandavas.
